ترتبطي (form VIII)
# تَرْتَبِطِي (tartabiṭī) /tar.ta.bi.tˤiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَبَطَ (irtabaṭa)
# تُرْتَبَطِي (turtabaṭī) /tur.ta.ba.tˤiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَبَطَ (irtabaṭa)
